_comment: ISSUE-KVD-SKILLS-A5ED0D — ordering + depth variant. The unknown block sits BEFORE the known keys and holds a nested sequence plus a 3-level mapping. Case 1 (`git status` -> 0) is the discriminator AND the leak detector: the unknown block's sequence items are deliberately `.*` and a `git status` regex, so if a tolerant parser ever mis-attributed them to `block_bash` the read-only command would start blocking. Cases 2/3 prove the KNOWN keys that FOLLOW the unknown block are still parsed (mode strict, both block_bash entries, both require_broker pairs) — i.e. the parse cursor was not left dangling.
